_comment: Which manifest shape each Kramerius document model produces.
This is data, not logic: adding a model Kramerius has introduced is an entry here, and the gateway
reads a configured directory over these defaults at startup, so it needs no rebuild.
`shape` must name one of the IiifStructure constants — PAGED_MANIFEST, MEDIA_MANIFEST,
CHILD_COLLECTION, VIRTUAL_COLLECTION. That set is deliberately NOT
configurable: the builder switches on it exhaustively, so a shape only exists if there is code that
knows how to build it. An unknown shape here fails at startup rather than at request time.
children          which children a CHILD_COLLECTION shape collects; required for it, unused otherwise.
fostersPages      pages belong to an ancestor, not to this model, so they are found through
foster_parents.pids rather than own_parent.pid. True for article, internalpart
hasAncestors      worth building a partOf block for. Whether the parent is actually linkable is
decided from the parent's own model, not from a list here.
excludesOwnModel  a member of the same model is skipped. Kramerius indexes a convolute as its own
child, which would otherwise make it a member of itself.
promoteTo         when children of `promoteWhen` exist, this model becomes that one instead. How a
monograph that turns out to have volumes becomes a multi-volume monograph.
